# envoy-go's fetch (.github/workflows/ci-job-envoy-go.yaml): the modules of every test package of the
# envoy module (the unit step, what the race build cannot run, the skip counter and its test, the
# store-form count, the integration test, the local stack callout-check.sh builds, the Dispatch
# store's connections command its sizing step runs), each tag its steps add, and the builds its
# tests make for other platforms (cmd/agent-secrets/modules_test.go, cmd/broker's outage test).
deps packages/envoy -test ./...
deps packages/envoy -test -tags natslive ./internal/testnats/ ./internal/bus/ ./internal/broker/natscallout/
deps packages/envoy -test -tags modellive ./agentloop/
deps packages/envoy -test -tags moto ./cmd/agent-secrets/
GOOS=darwin CGO_ENABLED=0 deps packages/envoy ./cmd/agent-secrets
GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 deps packages/envoy ./cmd/agent-secrets
GOOS=freebsd GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 deps packages/envoy ./cmd/agent-secrets
GOOS=linux GOARCH=386 CGO_ENABLED=0 deps packages/envoy ./cmd/agent-secrets
GOOS=linux CGO_ENABLED=0 deps packages/envoy ./cmd/broker
